high_level_description: The image showcases a unique piece of clothing displayed on a wooden hanger against a plain white wall. The garment appears to be a modern, avant-garde design with a predominantly white base fabric. It features an intricate arrangement of ribbons and straps in various colors, including yellow, purple, and gray, which are tied and draped in a complex pattern across the back. The ribbons create a dynamic and artistic effect, giving the garment a three-dimensional and almost sculptural quality.
